goal.en: Choose the exact word, and the exact partner for it — where advanced English is actually won or lost.
goal.ar: أن تختار الكلمة الدقيقة وقرينها الصحيح — وهنا تُكسب الإنجليزية المتقدمة أو تُخسر.

text.en: In formal writing the verb often carries little meaning; the noun does the work. Choosing the wrong support verb is the fastest way to sound translated.
text.ar: في الكتابة الرسمية يكاد الفعل يخلو من المعنى، والاسم هو الذي يحمله. واختيار الفعل المساند الخطأ أسرع ما يجعل نصّك يبدو مترجماً.

head: Natural
Not English
rows: put a question to the air

text.en: Several of these have a common alternative — you can also “make a distinction” or “carry out a review”. What matters is that the pairing exists, not that only one does.
text.ar: لبعضها بديل شائع أيضاً، فيصح make a distinction وcarry out a review. والمهم أن يكون الاقتران موجوداً في الاستعمال، لا أن يكون واحداً فقط.

text.en: “Very unlikely” is fine, but “highly unlikely” is what a proficient writer reaches for. “Strongly disappointed” and “deeply unlikely” are not wrong by rule — they are simply not said.
text.ar: تصح very unlikely، لكن المتمكّن يكتب highly unlikely. أما strongly disappointed وdeeply unlikely فليستا مخالفتين لقاعدة، لكنها ببساطة لا تُقال.

text.en: Record the adverb with its adjective, as one item. Learning them separately guarantees the wrong pairing later.
text.ar: احفظ الظرف مع صفته كوحدة واحدة، فحفظهما منفصلين يضمن الاقتران الخاطئ لاحقاً.

head: Word
The picture it gives
rows: not moving at all, and that is bad
stopping after a rise or fall

text.en: At this level, a wrong synonym is not a vocabulary gap — it is a factual error. “Sales plummeted” and “sales declined” describe different events.
text.ar: في هذا المستوى لا يكون المرادف الخطأ نقصاً في المفردات بل خطأً في الوقائع. فجملة sales plummeted تصف حدثاً مختلفاً عن sales declined.

text.en: Before choosing a word from a thesaurus, ask what shape of movement, size or speed it implies. If you cannot picture it, do not use it.
text.ar: قبل أن تأخذ كلمة من معجم المترادفات، اسأل: أي شكل من الحركة أو الحجم أو السرعة تُلمح إليه؟ فإن لم تستطع تصوّرها فلا تستخدمها.

questions.sentence: The author ___ a careful distinction between cause and correlation.

explanation.en: “Draw a distinction” is the standard academic pairing (“make” is also used).
explanation.ar: draw a distinction هو الاقتران الأكاديمي المعتاد، ويصح أيضاً make a distinction.

questions.sentence: The findings ___ support to the second hypothesis.

explanation.en: Evidence “lends support to” a claim — a fixed formal pairing.
explanation.ar: الدليل يقترن بـ lends support to، وهو اقتران رسمي ثابت.

prompt.en: Which sentence contains an unnatural pairing?
prompt.ar: أي جملة فيها اقتران غير طبيعي؟

options: The paper arrives a conclusion in its final section.
The paper reaches a conclusion in its final section.
The paper raises an objection in its second section.
The paper poses a question that it never answers.

explanation.en: You reach or come to a conclusion; “arrive” needs “at”, and even then “reach” is preferred here.
explanation.ar: نقول reach a conclusion أو come to a conclusion، وarrive تحتاج at، والمفضّل هنا reach.

prompt.en: Which verb goes with each noun?

explanation.en: These are the pairings a reader expects; anything else stops them mid-sentence.
explanation.ar: هذه هي الأزواج التي يتوقعها القارئ، وأي غيرها يوقفه في منتصف الجملة.

questions.sentence: It is ___ unlikely that the deadline will be met.

explanation.en: “Highly unlikely” is the fixed pairing; the others attach to different adjectives.
explanation.ar: highly unlikely اقتران ثابت، وبقية الظروف تلازم صفات أخرى.

questions.sentence: The committee was ___ concerned by the audit findings.

explanation.en: “Deeply concerned” is the standard pairing for serious worry.
explanation.ar: deeply concerned هو الاقتران المعتاد للتعبير عن قلق جدي.

prompt.en: Which sentence sounds like a proficient writer?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تبدو من كاتب متمكّن؟

options: She was bitterly disappointed by the decision.
She was strongly disappointed by the decision.
She was deeply disappointed at the decision made.
She was highly disappointed with the decision.

explanation.en: “Bitterly disappointed” is the established pairing. The others are understandable but not idiomatic.
explanation.ar: bitterly disappointed هو الاقتران المستقر، والبقية مفهومة لكنها ليست اصطلاحية.

prompt.en: Match the adverb with the adjective it partners.

explanation.en: Nothing about the meanings predicts these pairs — usage alone fixes them.
explanation.ar: لا شيء في المعاني يتنبأ بهذه الأزواج، فالاستعمال وحده هو الذي ثبّتها.

questions.sentence: After the announcement, the share price ___ from 90 to 31 in a single morning.

explanation.en: A sudden, steep fall is “plummeted”. “Declined” would suggest something gradual.
explanation.ar: السقوط المفاجئ الحاد يُعبَّر عنه بـ plummeted، أما declined فتوحي بانخفاض تدريجي.

questions.sentence: Membership has ___ from four hundred to barely thirty over two decades.

explanation.en: “Dwindled” is a long slow shrinking to almost nothing — exactly what two decades implies.
explanation.ar: dwindled تعني تضاؤلاً بطيئاً طويلاً حتى الاقتراب من العدم، وهو ما يوحي به عقدان من الزمن.

prompt.en: Which word says the figure stayed the same, and that this is a problem?
prompt.ar: أي كلمة تعني أن الرقم ظل ثابتاً وأن ذلك مشكلة؟

explanation.en: “Stagnate” carries a negative judgement; “levelled off” and “held steady” are neutral.
explanation.ar: stagnate تحمل حكماً سلبياً، أما levelled off وheld steady فمحايدتان.

prompt.en: Which sentence describes the data inaccurately?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تصف البيانات وصفاً غير دقيق؟

options: Revenue plummeted steadily across the whole decade.
Revenue declined steadily across the whole decade.
Revenue fluctuated sharply throughout the decade.
Revenue levelled off in the second half of the decade.

explanation.en: “Plummet” is sudden by definition, so it cannot happen “steadily” over ten years.
explanation.ar: فعل plummet مفاجئ بطبيعته، فلا يمكن أن يقع «باطراد» على مدى عشر سنوات.

prompt.en: Match the verb with the movement it describes.

explanation.en: Choosing between these is a factual decision, not a stylistic one.
explanation.ar: الاختيار بينها قرار يتعلق بالوقائع لا بالأسلوب.

prompt.en: Complete with one verb: “The study ___ a question that previous work had ignored.”
prompt.ar: أكمل بفعل واحد: The study ___ a question that previous work had ignored.

explanation.en: “Poses” or “raises” a question; both are standard in academic prose.
explanation.ar: نقول poses a question أو raises a question، وكلاهما معتاد في النثر الأكاديمي.

prompt.en: Which sentence would an editor leave untouched?
prompt.ar: أي جملة يتركها المحرّر كما هي؟

options: The theory is widely regarded as the most convincing account.
The theory is deeply regarded as the most convincing account.
The theory is highly regarded like the most convincing account.
The theory is strongly regarded to be the most convincing one.

explanation.en: “Widely regarded as” is the fixed phrase, including the preposition “as”.
explanation.ar: widely regarded as عبارة ثابتة بحرف الجر as.
